mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.name, a.category_id, ac.name AS category_name, a.description, a.address, a.city, a.province, a.district, a.scenic_level, a.longitude, a.latitude, a.open_time, a.ticket_price, a.charge_type, a.suggested_duration, a.best_months, a.scene_type, a.rating, a.view_count, a.favorite_count, a.contact_phone, a.official_website, a.seasonal_status, a.seasonal_note, a.create_time, CASE WHEN f.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_favorited, CASE WHEN uf.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_visited FROM attraction a LEFT JOIN attraction_category ac ON a.category_id = ac.id LEFT JOIN favorite f ON a.id = f.item_id AND f.item_type = 'attraction' AND f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_footprint uf ON a.id = uf.attraction_id AND uf.user_id = #{userId} WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.deleted = 0

SELECT a.id, a.name, a.category_id, ac.name AS category_name, a.description, a.address, a.city, a.province, a.district, a.scenic_level, a.longitude, a.latitude, a.open_time, a.ticket_price, a.charge_type, a.suggested_duration, a.best_months, a.scene_type, COALESCE(rs.avg_rating, 0) AS rating, COALESCE(rs.rating_count, 0) AS rating_count, a.view_count, a.favorite_count, a.contact_phone, a.official_website, a.seasonal_status, a.seasonal_note, a.create_time FROM attraction a LEFT JOIN attraction_category ac ON a.category_id = ac.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT attraction_id, ROUND(AVG(overall_score), 1) AS avg_rating, COUNT(*) AS rating_count FROM attraction_rating WHERE overall_score > 0 GROUP BY attraction_id ) rs ON a.id = rs.attraction_id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.audit_status = 1 AND a.id != #{attractionId} AND (a.category_id = #{categoryId} OR a.city = #{city}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN a.category_id = #{categoryId} THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, COALESCE(rs.avg_rating, 0) DESC, a.view_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.id, a.name, a.city, a.scenic_level, a.view_count, a.favorite_count, a.rating, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attraction_rating WHERE attraction_id = a.id) AS rating_count, (a.view_count * 0.3 + a.favorite_count * 0.5 + IFNULL(a.rating, 0) * 20 * 0.2) AS hot_score FROM attraction a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.audit_status = 1 ORDER BY hot_score DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.id, a.name, a.city, a.scenic_level, a.view_count, a.favorite_count, a.rating, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attraction_rating WHERE attraction_id = a.id) AS rating_count, IFNULL( ((a.view_count + a.favorite_count) - (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(view_count + favorite_count), 0) FROM attraction WHERE id = a.id AND create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY))) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT IFNULL(SUM(view_count + favorite_count), 1) FROM attraction WHERE id = a.id AND create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)), 0), 0 ) AS growth_rate FROM attraction a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.audit_status = 1 AND a.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ORDER BY growth_rate DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT DISTINCT province FROM attraction WHERE deleted = 0 AND province IS NOT NULL AND province != '' ORDER BY province
SELECT DISTINCT scenic_level FROM attraction WHERE deleted = 0 AND scenic_level IS NOT NULL AND scenic_level != '' ORDER BY scenic_level
SELECT DISTINCT scene_type FROM attraction WHERE deleted = 0 AND scene_type IS NOT NULL AND scene_type != ''
SELECT DISTINCT suggested_duration FROM attraction WHERE deleted = 0 AND suggested_duration IS NOT NULL AND suggested_duration != '' ORDER BY suggested_duration
SELECT DISTINCT city FROM attraction WHERE deleted = 0 AND province = #{province} AND city IS NOT NULL AND city != '' ORDER BY city
SELECT DISTINCT district FROM attraction WHERE deleted = 0 AND city = #{city} AND district IS NOT NULL AND district != '' ORDER BY district
SELECT DISTINCT province, city FROM attraction WHERE deleted = 0 AND province IS NOT NULL AND province != '' AND city IS NOT NULL AND city != '' ORDER BY province, city
